Initial release of Caption Generator Bangla — Add Bangla Captions to Videos:

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB and automatically generate Bangla captions for videos.
- Simple, guided process: connect, upload, instruct, and get downloadable captioned videos in 30–60 seconds.
- No editing software or manual transcription required; all rendering and text recognition happen server-side on cloud GPU.
- Supports checking credits, export/download, and session management.
- Handles errors gracefully, provides helpful tips, and supports multiple editing workflows for Bengali content creators.
